_comment: DIAB GS30 grid-scored core WITH per-surface stochastic resin halo (notes/novel.md, notes/refs/laustsen2014_grid_scored_rve.md). Saw-cut groove walls+root: opened cells, full halo from core.cell_size. Unsawn top/bottom faces: closed cells, thinner halo (face.scale x saw_cut reach, default 0.25). P(resin)=max over active surfaces; local stiffness is P*C_resin+(1-P)*C_foam at Gauss points. scoring.sampling: exact or local_cloud. Requires numpy backend.
